resources.string: Explicit videos are processed in full. Timestamps are not used to select a clip.
YouTube captions do not require a provider. To use STT, first add your own API key in Settings.
Allow STT after failed retrieval attempts
A locally cancelled job may continue at the provider. Costs are not automatically incurred again.
Budget in US dollars (blank: no local limit)
This source is already in the history. Starting it will explicitly create another run.
Share a YouTube video with SourceScribe or enter a link under “New source.”
Technically incomplete: review the notes and missing sections.
Public YouTube source for the functional test
yt-dlp and EJS are signature-verified together. Python, the JavaScript runtime, and FFmpeg require an APK update. Running jobs keep their engine.
The operation could not be completed.
Submission uncertain – do not retry automatically
STT requires a provider, model, and matching saved key.
The selected audio version may differ from the original.
No telemetry. Keys remain on this device. External STT begins when you start the job.
Estimated base price: %1$s USD · pricing as of %2$s
Price unknown – no promise of free use
This job requires its original key. Open Settings and select “Restore missing key” for the same provider and region.
Notifications are off. You can find progress in the history; execution remains subject to Android background restrictions.
Cancelled locally. Submission or remote processing may already be running and may continue to incur costs. Do not resubmit without noticing.
The transcript remains stored internally. Select a writable folder to export it.
Enter a valid cost limit or leave the field blank.
Enter a maximum audio duration between 1 and 600 minutes.
The selected options are not supported by the model. Check the advanced settings.
Deletion scheduled. Local processing will be stopped first.
Internal results and audio files used only here will be deleted. External exports remain available. Accepted or uncertain provider jobs may continue and incur costs.

A new attempt uses the saved settings and the same local cost limit. Existing results remain available. Accepted or uncertain jobs may incur additional charges. Confirm only if you explicitly want to run the job again.
The preview contains technical versions, state counters, and known error codes. Nothing is shared until you select it.
All requested branches already have a complete result.
Local processing is still running. Cancel it and wait for it to finish first.
Export failed; internal result remains available
Replacement for %1$s · %2$s. Existing jobs retain this key reference; provider and region remain unchanged.
The internal storage limit or available device storage is insufficient. Saved results remain available.
The next job exceeds the saved local cost limit. Accepted and uncertain jobs are included.

Deletes the transcripts and audio data stored for this job at AssemblyAI through its API. Local results remain available. This does not confirm that ongoing processing has stopped and is not a refund. Confirmation appears only after a successful provider response.
AssemblyAI confirmed the data deletion. This does not confirm a refund.
No undeleted AssemblyAI job ID is available.
Provider is processing · %1$s since job started
Large text: copy a section or share the complete file.
The selected caption track is no longer available. Check the source again and confirm a new run with the desired track.
Restore the key for existing jobs using %1$s · %2$s. Use the same provider account so existing remote jobs remain accessible. Then explicitly resume the waiting job.
The external file is missing. The internal result remains available.
The export was interrupted. Any partial file remains in the destination folder; saving again creates a new file.
The selected audio track is no longer available. Check the source again and select an available track.
The required audio file is no longer available. Import the original file again before confirming a new run.
The job was saved but could not be scheduled. Select Resume to schedule it again.
Another action is still running. Try this action again afterward.
The result is saved internally. The export could not be scheduled; select Retry export.
Check the source again under New source and select a caption track. Resuming alone does not change the saved track selection.

The verified audio data or responses for this partial retry are missing or have changed. The previous result remains available. A full new run must be confirmed separately and may incur additional costs.
The saved key is locked or corrupted. Unlock the device and try again. If the error persists, replace the key in Settings for the same provider and region, then explicitly resume the job.
The key could not be stored or read securely. Check the available device storage and try again. Existing jobs retain their key reference.
A provider response already exists for a missing section. “Retry missing branch” is disabled so this response does not incur further costs. The existing partial result remains available.
The saved job settings are corrupted. This job will not resume automatically. Existing results and other jobs remain available.
The internally stored result file is missing or was not saved completely. Other results remain available. No new transcription is requested automatically.
